hardware.scheduling: normal Windows scheduling; serial processes; no CPU affinity override

implementation.hash_method: SHA-256 of canonical sorted JSON mapping relative source keys to SHA-256 values; ASCII JSON with comma/colon separators.

rg_gui.identity_note: Content hashes identify the measured working tree; the Git revision alone may not describe it.

imgui.branch_note: Integration branch; exact source is identified by revision and content hash.

imgui-docking.branch_note: Integration branch; exact source is identified by revision and content hash.

protocol.execution: Serial processes; library order alternates across six trials; workload order rotates.
protocol.trial_percentiles: Nearest-rank over individual measured frames; all measured frames retained.
protocol.group_percentiles: Median of six per-trial percentiles; max is worst across trials; trial ranges are not confidence intervals.
protocol.group_mean: mean is median of trial means; pooled_mean is arithmetic mean across all equal-length trials.
protocol.reproducibility: Project measurements with disclosed configuration and source identities. The comparison harness and raw captures are private; hashes alone do not enable public reproduction.

configuration.font: Common prebaked Inter 16 atlas, glyph metrics and texture; font loading is outside measured frames.
configuration.kerning: Disabled in every adapter; this differs from rg_gui's default kerning-enabled text.
configuration.shapes: Shape antialiasing and rounding disabled; native widget and docking shapes still differ.
configuration.fixtures: Shared scene generation, application list virtualization/filtering and common layout setup occur outside frame timing; native widget formatting is timed.
configuration.rg_gui: Shipping indexed API; shared ASCII lookup; 32-quad cache pages; optional multiline editor layout cache; viewport storage callback; helper-sized rings for every flight slot.
configuration.dear_imgui: Native widgets and official SDL_GPU renderer; common immutable font imported through internal font-loader APIs; no extra font rasterization/upload.
configuration.docking: Core uses mainline ImGui. Tools use docking branch; docking is enabled only for docked_workspace. Native viewports are not part of this matrix.

metric_definitions.ui: Native widget submission and CPU renderer preparation.
metric_definitions.frame: CPU frame-loop wall time including queue throttle and, at one flight, waiting for submitted GPU completion.
metric_definitions.active: Events + UI + encoding + secondary processing + submission; excludes acquisition, throttle and explicit completion wait.
metric_definitions.complete: CPU-observed completion duration only at one flight; unavailable and recorded as zero at two flights.
metric_definitions.observed_completion: Delayed CPU fence observation, an upper bound rather than a GPU timestamp.
metric_definitions.completed_frames_per_second: Completed production rate including final queue drain, not display FPS.
metric_definitions.memory_bytes: Peak explicit adapter reservations after warmup, including selected flight slots; common font/targets reported separately; not process memory or resident VRAM.
metric_definitions.glyphs: Unavailable for ImGui and recorded as zero, not a claim of zero rendered text.

workloads.name: Static labels
workloads.description: 128 labels with unchanged text and fixed positions.

workloads.name: Changing labels
workloads.description: 128 labels cycling a fixed 16-frame changing-text corpus.

workloads.name: Inspector
workloads.description: 32 native checkboxes and 32 native sliders with changing numeric values.

workloads.name: Virtualized list
workloads.description: 32 visible text rows from 10,000 assets; application virtualization occurs before timing.

workloads.name: Mixed inspector
workloads.description: 32 native checkboxes and 32 sliders, replayed checkbox clicks and slider drags, plus changing values.

workloads.name: Asset browser
workloads.description: Filter input and up to 32 visible asset rows with selection/filter interactions; application filtering and virtualization occur before timing.

workloads.name: Text editor
workloads.description: One multiline editor initialized with 8 KiB of text and replayed editing/selection events.

workloads.name: Docked workspace
workloads.description: Four docked panels with 64 changing labels, splitter drag, tab rearrangement and periodic layout restoration.

validation.pixel_scope: Saved core text images and inspector numeric regions tolerate two color levels. Tool screenshots/semantic checks do not establish cross-library pixel identity.

limitations: One Windows/D3D12 machine and these eight workloads; no whole-library speed ranking or cross-platform claim.
CPU wall/fence measurements are not GPU timestamps, display FPS, scanout or input-to-photon latency.
Shared fixtures exclude application scene-generation/filtering cost; font baking, initialization and cold first frames are outside the steady-state table.
Library configurations are explicitly chosen for this comparison, not every library's untouched defaults.
Opaque SDL/driver allocations, allocator overhead and memory residency are not measured.
All six trials, adverse tails and allocations are retained; no performance threshold filters the publication data.
Dependency worktrees may contain local changes; use recorded dirty status and content identities rather than treating every Git revision as a clean release.
